name: Mobile Timer for Toggl Track
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Coordinates timer requests and saved queue progress across disable and re-enable.
A refresh that sends the offline queue no longer hangs the timer.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Turning the plugin off and on again no longer loses timer requests or queued progress.
A refresh that sends queued offline time no longer freezes the timer.
tip: Add a toggl-project property to a note so Start timer for this note uses it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Mobile Timer for Toggl Track is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to track your time.
